tasks.short: Interpret glazing drawings and installation requirements

steps.what: Read and interpret blueprints to determine glass, framing and installation requirements

tasks.design: Retain drawing and specification interpretation in {DOCS}. The glazier resolves ambiguity about glass, framing, access and installation before work; no extractor is treated as authoritative for physical fit or safe staging.
tasks.previous_blocker: Drawing information must be reconciled with practical installation conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Document access does not remove interpretation of glazing and access requirements.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting revisions and unusual installation details require clarification.
tasks.human_edge: The glazier recognises missing practical information before it becomes an installation problem.
tasks.altitude: Interpretation responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify access and staging constraints before installation
reach.learn: Drawing revision and site coordination practices

evidence.claim: Keeping glazing specification interpretation human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge; the digest's construction paperwork capabilities do not validate automatic drawing interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary is interpretation, excluding measuring as built, glass selection and physical installation.
No free structured glass dimensions, installation method or staging decision is assumed.
Existing document tools remain; no custom interpretation system is proposed.
Zero upkeep because the task does not change.
research_questions: Which drawing ambiguities require clarification before specifying glazing or staging?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Interpretation remains human; no hypothetical drawing-entry baseline is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Discuss customer requirements and provide cost estimates

steps.what: Confer with customers and capture the scope and estimating assumptions
Calculate the estimate from chosen quantities, rates and allowances
Check and explain the cost estimate and its conditions to the customer

tasks.design: Configure a fixed estimate worksheet in {SPREADSHEET} using the glazier's selected quantities, rates and allowances. Keep scope discussion, input capture and explanation with the glazier; the worksheet performs arithmetic and does not choose a glass specification or assess site risk.
tasks.previous_blocker: Estimate arithmetic can be repeated manually after the scope has been chosen.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas can repeat the selected quantity-and-rate calculation.
tasks.still_hard: Unverified dimensions, access constraints and exclusions can invalidate a price.
tasks.human_edge: The glazier recognises uncertainty and explains when a provisional estimate needs a site check.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated estimate arithmetic, with scope and commercial judgement unchanged.

reach.task: Present explicit glazing estimate assumptions for review

evidence.claim: Formula-based glazing estimate arithmetic is an E1 design from model knowledge; no digest source establishes a glazing-estimate case.

assumptions: Boundary is discussion and provisional cost estimating, not final manufacturing dimensions or an instruction to cut glass.

In s1 the glazier captures chosen glass item, quantity, unit, provisional dimensions or area, rate and source date, labour allowance, access allowance, tax treatment and exclusions. All 45 hours remain for discussion and capture. Missing or unverified fields require manual estimating or a stated provisional allowance, not inferred dimensions.
Test native estimate templates before custom code; no free structured address, catalogue selection or site-risk flag is assumed. Already-formula-driven arithmetic earns no new saving.
Allow four focal hours for rate updates and unusual-estimate reconciliation beyond routine checks.
unknowns: Availability of checked rates and project quantities
research_questions: Does the worksheet reproduce independently checked estimates while keeping provisional quantities and exclusions visible?

already_counted.description: Scope capture and estimate check and explanation

approvals.approved_version: Exact estimate version, customer, scope, rates, provisional quantities and exclusions; changes require another glazier check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 minus4 upkeep =16 net. High assumes repeated hand arithmetic; low covers an existing calculation template. Customer discussion and verification retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select glass or mirror type and colour

steps.what: Select the type or color of glass or mirror against specifications

tasks.design: Retain specification matching and sample judgement with the glazier. Product information in {DOCS} supports the choice; a colour name or catalogue filter alone does not establish equivalent appearance or suitability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Nominally similar glass can differ in appearance and required characteristics.
tasks.enabler_now: Catalogue access does not remove specification and sample checks.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous colour descriptions and installation requirements need clarification.
tasks.human_edge: The glazier notices mismatches and obtains a decision before substituting material.
tasks.altitude: Glass-selection responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain why a proposed glass substitute needs review

evidence.claim: Keeping glass type and colour selection human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is choosing glass against requirements, excluding original drawing interpretation and purchasing.
No structured suitable-substitute flag or automatic product decision is presumed.
Existing product information and samples remain; no custom tool is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no process changes.
research_questions: Which specification or sample mismatches require clarification before material selection?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Material judgement remains counted; no guessed catalogue-retyping share is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated cost arithmetic where it exists while preserving interpretation, customer discussion and glass selection.
reach: Clarify estimate assumptions with construction estimators
Explain substitution concerns to purchasing staff
role.ambitious_version: A glazier who gives clear estimates and resolves material and installation uncertainty before committing the job.
